description: Issue #1841 — a synthetic B2B ordering portal's requirements and analyst questions for chat's list_requirements. `expected` is the requirement that answers the question, or null when none does. Invented content only.

requirements.title: Deferred settlement terms
requirements.body: Approved trade accounts may settle an invoice up to 60 days after delivery.

requirements.title: Export invoices to CSV
requirements.body: Finance exports the month's invoices to a CSV file for the accounting system.

requirements.title: Reset a forgotten password
requirements.body: A user who forgot their password gets a reset link by email.

requirements.title: Two-factor sign-in
requirements.body: Users confirm each sign-in with a code from an authenticator app.

requirements.title: Monthly customer statement
requirements.body: Each customer receives a monthly statement of open invoices and payments received.

requirements.title: Bulk order upload
requirements.body: Buyers upload a spreadsheet of SKUs and quantities to create one order.

requirements.title: Reorder from history
requirements.body: Buyers repeat a previous order in one click from their order history.

requirements.title: Credit limit check
requirements.body: An order that would take an account over its credit limit is held for review by finance.

requirements.title: Volume price breaks
requirements.body: Unit prices drop at 100, 500 and 1,000 units of the same SKU.

requirements.title: Delivery slot booking
requirements.body: Buyers choose a two-hour delivery window at checkout.

requirements.title: Shipment tracking
requirements.body: Buyers follow each shipment's progress with the carrier's tracking number.

requirements.title: Return authorisation
requirements.body: Buyers request a return for damaged goods within 14 days and get an RMA number.

requirements.title: Multiple delivery addresses
requirements.body: An account can store several delivery addresses and pick one per order.

requirements.title: Purchase order number on invoices
requirements.body: Buyers enter their own PO number at checkout and it is printed on the invoice.

requirements.title: Approval workflow for large orders
requirements.body: Orders above 5,000 placed by junior buyers need a manager's approval.

requirements.title: Product search by SKU
requirements.body: Buyers find a product by typing its exact SKU.

requirements.title: Stock availability display
requirements.body: Each product page shows whether the item is in stock at the nearest warehouse.

requirements.title: Account user roles
requirements.body: An account administrator invites colleagues and gives each a buyer or viewer role.

requirements.title: Audit trail of order changes
requirements.body: Every change to an order is logged with who made it and when.

requirements.title: VAT exemption certificates
requirements.body: Exempt customers upload a certificate and are not charged VAT.

requirements.title: Email order confirmation
requirements.body: The buyer receives an email confirming each order with its lines and total.

requirements.title: Saved shopping lists
requirements.body: Buyers keep named lists of products they order often.

requirements.title: Cookie consent banner
requirements.body: Visitors accept or reject analytics cookies on their first visit.

requirements.title: Session timeout
requirements.body: A signed-in user is signed out after 30 minutes without activity.
